Data File Required: Payment Register / AP Ledger / Expense Claim Register
Key Fields Required: Vendor/Payee ID, Invoice No, Invoice Date, Amount, Payment Date
Objective / Red Flag: Detect vendors/payees paid twice for the same invoice/claim.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Group by Payee+Amount+Invoice No (exact duplicate); also group by Payee+Amount+Date(+/-3 days) to catch re-keyed near-duplicates with a different reference number.
Suggested Tool: Excel COUNTIFS / Power Query group-by / Python pandas.duplicated()
Red Flag Threshold: Any exact duplicate; near-duplicate within 3 days flagged for review
Follow-up Action: Trace to bank statement for double debit; confirm recovery or credit note raised

Objective / Red Flag: Same invoice number used more than once by the same vendor.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: COUNTIFS(Vendor, InvoiceNo) > 1
Red Flag Threshold: >1 occurrence for the same vendor+invoice number
Follow-up Action: Verify against original invoice copies; check for double booking

Data File Required: Sales Invoice Register / Delivery Challan or E-way Bill Register
Objective / Red Flag: Identify missing or out-of-sequence numbered documents, indicating unrecorded or suppressed transactions.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Sort the numeric part of the document number ascending; compute the difference between consecutive numbers; flag gaps >1 and out-of-sequence dates.
Suggested Tool: Excel sort + formula (=A2-A1) / Python set-difference against expected range
Red Flag Threshold: Any gap not matched to a cancelled/void document on record
Follow-up Action: Obtain explanation and copy of the missing/cancelled document

Data File Required: Sales Register / Purchase Register / GL transaction listing
Objective / Red Flag: Test whether the first-digit distribution of amounts follows Benford's expected distribution; a significant deviation may indicate fabricated figures.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Extract the first digit of each amount; compute actual % frequency for digits 1-9; compare to Benford's expected % (1: 30.1%, 2: 17.6% ... 9: 4.6%).
Suggested Tool: Excel LEFT + COUNTIF / Python (benford-ish package or manual chi-square)
Red Flag Threshold: Deviation >5 percentage points on a digit, or a failed chi-square test at 5% significance
Follow-up Action: Investigate the population/transactions driving the deviation - use as a risk indicator, not standalone proof

Data File Required: Journal Entry Listing / Sales Register / Credit Note Register
Objective / Red Flag: Identify entries in exact round figures, statistically less common in genuine transactions.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: MOD(Amount,1000)=0 (adjust the rounding unit to entity materiality); count and value the round-sum population as a % of total.
Red Flag Threshold: Round entries exceeding 5-10% of population value, or any individually material round entry
Follow-up Action: Obtain rationale/support for each flagged material entry

Data File Required: Payment Register / Purchase Order Register / JE Listing
Objective / Red Flag: Identify transactions clustered just below an approval/authorization threshold, indicating deliberate structuring.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: COUNTIFS(Amount,">="&Threshold*0.9,"<"&Threshold) - count and value of transactions in the 90-100% band below threshold; compare to the overall distribution shape.
Red Flag Threshold: Disproportionate clustering just below threshold vs a smooth distribution elsewhere
Follow-up Action: Identify the preparer/approver pattern involved; discuss with management

Data File Required: Journal Entry Listing / Bank Payment Register
Objective / Red Flag: Identify postings made on non-business days, which may indicate unauthorized activity.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: WEEKDAY(Date,2)>5 flags Saturday/Sunday; cross-reference a public-holiday list for holiday postings.
Red Flag Threshold: Any weekend/holiday posting, particularly by users without a documented business reason
Follow-up Action: Obtain business justification and evidence of authorization

Objective / Red Flag: Identify entries posted outside normal business hours - a common fraud indicator.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Extract the time portion of the timestamp; flag entries outside the entity's normal hours (e.g. before 9am / after 7pm).
Red Flag Threshold: Entries outside business hours, particularly by senior/admin users
Follow-up Action: Corroborate the business reason for after-hours access/posting

Key Fields Required: User ID, User Role, Account Debited, Account Credited, Amount
Objective / Red Flag: Identify JEs posted by users outside the routine accounts team, or postings to unusual account-pair combinations.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Anti-join the posting User ID list against the authorized finance-user list; separately compare posted account pairs to a maintained 'unusual combination' rule list.
Red Flag Threshold: Any posting by a non-finance user; any match to the unusual-combination list
Follow-up Action: Obtain explanation and verify approval evidence for each flagged entry

Objective / Red Flag: Identify JEs with blank or generic narration, reducing transparency and enabling concealment.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: ISBLANK(Narration) or LEN(Narration)<10, or narration matches a list of generic terms ('adjustment', 'misc', 'correction').
Red Flag Threshold: Any material JE with no or generic narration
Follow-up Action: Request supporting rationale from the preparer

Data File Required: Journal Entry Listing spanning period-end and the following period
Objective / Red Flag: Identify entries posted near period-end that are exactly reversed shortly after, indicating possible earnings management.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Self-join entries where Account+Amount appear as opposite Dr/Cr pairs within a defined window (e.g. 10 days) before/after period-end.
Suggested Tool: Power Query self-join / Python pandas merge
Red Flag Threshold: Any material reversing pair spanning a reporting date
Follow-up Action: Assess business rationale and whether reported results at the cut-off date were affected

Key Fields Required: User ID, Entry Count, Entry Value
Objective / Red Flag: Identify unusual concentration of JE volume/value in a single user, especially outside their normal role.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: PivotTable of count and sum of JEs by User ID; rank and compare to the user's documented job role.
Red Flag Threshold: Disproportionate share of JE volume/value relative to the user's role
Follow-up Action: Corroborate with the role/responsibility matrix; investigate outliers

Objective / Red Flag: Identify vendor bank accounts matching an employee's personal bank account - a strong fictitious/shell-vendor indicator.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Exact match of Bank Account Number (and IFSC) between the two master files.
Red Flag Threshold: Any exact match
Follow-up Action: High-priority investigation: verify vendor legitimacy, trace transaction/payment history

Objective / Red Flag: Identify vendors sharing PAN, address, phone or a personal email domain with an employee/director.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Fuzzy/exact match on PAN and normalized address/phone across the two masters.
Suggested Tool: Power Query merge / Python fuzzy matching (e.g. fuzzywuzzy/rapidfuzz)
Red Flag Threshold: Any match
Follow-up Action: Cross-check against the Related Party Register; assess disclosure requirement

Objective / Red Flag: Identify multiple POs to the same vendor around the same date whose combined value exceeds an approval threshold.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Group by Vendor+Date(+/-2 days); sum PO Amount; flag groups where individual POs are below threshold but the sum is at/above it.
Red Flag Threshold: Combined value crossing an approval threshold within a short window
Follow-up Action: Review approval trail and rationale for the split; identify the requester

Data File Required: PO Register + GRN Register + Purchase Invoice Register
Key Fields Required: PO No, GRN No, Invoice No, Quantity, Price, Vendor
Objective / Red Flag: Identify invoices booked/paid without a matching PO/GRN, or with quantity/price mismatches beyond tolerance.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Join Invoice to PO and GRN on PO number; flag unmatched invoices and quantity/price variances beyond a defined tolerance (e.g. 2%).
Red Flag Threshold: Any invoice without PO/GRN; variance beyond tolerance
Follow-up Action: Investigate unmatched/variant items with the purchase/stores team

Objective / Red Flag: Identify transactions invoiced at a price different from the approved master.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: VLOOKUP the invoiced price against the price master; compute % variance; flag beyond tolerance.
Red Flag Threshold: Variance beyond tolerance (e.g. 2-5%) without documented approval
Follow-up Action: Verify approval evidence for the deviation

Data File Required: AR/AP Sub-ledger or Inventory Stock Ledger
Key Fields Required: Party/Item, Amount, Transaction Date, As-of Date
Objective / Red Flag: Bucket balances by age and identify unusually old or large balances for follow-up/provisioning.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Ageing = As-of Date minus Transaction Date; nested IF/IFS to bucket (0-30/31-60/61-90/90+); PivotTable to summarise.
Red Flag Threshold: Balances aged beyond agreed credit terms, or individually large old balances
Follow-up Action: Obtain subsequent recovery/movement evidence; assess provisioning adequacy

Objective / Red Flag: Identify near-duplicate vendor/customer records under different names sharing the same identifiers.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Group by PAN/GSTIN/Bank Account; flag groups containing more than one distinct Name.
Suggested Tool: Excel COUNTIFS / Power Query group-by / fuzzy name matching
Red Flag Threshold: Any group with duplicate identifiers under different names
Follow-up Action: Investigate business rationale for multiple records; assess for structuring/related party concealment

Key Fields Required: Vendor GSTIN, Invoice No, Invoice Date, Taxable Value, GST Amount
Objective / Red Flag: Identify ITC claimed in books but not reflected in GSTR-2B, and vice versa.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Join on GSTIN+Invoice No (or GSTIN+Amount+Date where invoice number formats differ); flag unmatched/variance items.
Suggested Tool: Power Query merge / Python pandas merge
Red Flag Threshold: Any material unmatched ITC
Follow-up Action: Assess reversal requirement with interest; pursue vendor for correction/upload

Key Fields Required: Customer GSTIN, Invoice No, Taxable Value, GST Amount
Objective / Red Flag: Identify sales recorded in books but not reported in GSTR-1, or vice versa.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Join/compare on Invoice No/Amount; flag differences.
Red Flag Threshold: Any material mismatch
Follow-up Action: Assess need for amendment in the next return / DRC-03 payment

Key Fields Required: Deductee PAN, Section, Amount Deducted, Challan/BSR details
Objective / Red Flag: Identify TDS deducted per books but not deposited/reflected in 26AS, or rate mismatches.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Join on PAN+Section+Amount; flag unmatched or variance items.
Red Flag Threshold: Any unmatched or short-deducted item
Follow-up Action: Compute interest exposure under Section 201; verify subsequent correction filed

Objective / Red Flag: Identify items with negative or otherwise illogical closing stock quantities.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Filter Closing Quantity < 0.
Red Flag Threshold: Any negative balance
Follow-up Action: Investigate root cause - unrecorded purchase, data-entry error, or theft

Objective / Red Flag: Identify unusual spikes in returns by customer, sales person or period, potentially indicating channel-stuffing.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: PivotTable of return value by month/customer/sales person; compute Z-score to identify outliers.
Red Flag Threshold: >2 standard deviations from the mean, or concentration in a single customer/sales person
Follow-up Action: Investigate the outlier's drivers with the sales team

Data File Required: Employee Master / Payroll Bank Transfer File
Key Fields Required: Employee ID, Bank Account Number, IFSC
Objective / Red Flag: Identify two or more employee records sharing a bank account - a ghost-employee indicator.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: COUNTIFS grouped by Bank Account Number; flag groups with >1 distinct Employee ID.
Red Flag Threshold: Any duplicate account across distinct Employee IDs
Follow-up Action: Verify employee existence via HR/biometric attendance records

Objective / Red Flag: Identify employees with unexplained month-on-month salary spikes/drops.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Compute % change month-over-month per employee; flag beyond a defined tolerance (e.g. +/-20%) without a corresponding HR change event.
Red Flag Threshold: Variance beyond tolerance without HR documentation
Follow-up Action: Trace to HR approval for increment/change

Objective / Red Flag: Identify duplicate asset tags indicating double-counting or data-entry errors.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: COUNTIF(AssetTag) > 1.
Red Flag Threshold: Any duplicate
Follow-up Action: Physically verify and correct the fixed asset register

Key Fields Required: Amount, Party, Date, Mode of Payment
Objective / Red Flag: Identify cash transactions at or just below statutory disallowance/reporting thresholds (e.g. Sec 40A(3) Rs 10,000; Sec 269ST Rs 2,00,000; Sec 269SS/269T loan limits Rs 20,000).
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Filter Mode=Cash and Amount within a defined band below each threshold; also check same-party same-day multiple cash transactions summing above the threshold.
Red Flag Threshold: Any transaction/cluster within the structuring band
Follow-up Action: Assess disallowance/penalty exposure; discuss with management/tax consultant

Data File Required: Vendor Master + Customer Master + Related Party Register + Employee/Director Master
Objective / Red Flag: Identify vendors/customers whose identifiers match or resemble a director/promoter/employee or a declared related party.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Exact/fuzzy match of Name, PAN, Address, Bank Account across the master files; flag matches not already on the Related Party Register.
Suggested Tool: Power Query merge / Python fuzzy matching
Red Flag Threshold: Any match not disclosed
Follow-up Action: Assess disclosure and arm's-length pricing requirements

Data File Required: Sales Register + Delivery/E-way Bill Register, or Purchase/Expense Register + GRN
Objective / Red Flag: Identify transactions recorded in one period but delivered/received in another.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: For transactions within a defined window of period-end, compare the transaction date to the delivery/receipt date; flag where they fall in different accounting periods.
Red Flag Threshold: Any mismatch within the cut-off window, weighted by materiality
Follow-up Action: Assess the correct period; propose an adjustment if material

Objective / Red Flag: Identify sales persons or customers with disproportionately high discounts/credit notes relative to peers.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: PivotTable of average discount %/credit note value by sales person and customer; rank and flag outliers.
Red Flag Threshold: Materially above peer average (e.g. >2x the average)
Follow-up Action: Investigate business rationale; review approval evidence

Objective / Red Flag: Identify account balances/ratios deviating significantly from historical trend or budget.
Test Logic (Excel / Power Query / Python: Compute period-on-period % change and key ratios (GP margin, expense-to-revenue, debtor/creditor days); flag variances beyond a defined tolerance.
Suggested Tool: Excel PivotTable + trend formulas / Python pandas
Red Flag Threshold: Variance beyond tolerance (e.g. >15-20%) without documented explanation
Follow-up Action: Obtain management explanation; corroborate with supporting evidence
